facts: Spotify reported its fourth quarter 2024 earnings on February 4, 2025, marking its first full year of profitability.
Monthly Active Users grew 12% year-over-year to reach 675 million.
Subscribers increased 11% year-over-year to total 263 million.
Total Revenue rose 16% year-over-year to €4.2 billion.
Gross Margin climbed by 555 basis points year-over-year to 32.2%, and Operating Income rose to €477 million.
Daniel Ek serves as the Founder and CEO of Spotify.
missing: Net income or net profit figures for the fourth quarter or the full year of 2024.
Full-year revenue and subscriber totals for 2024 alongside the Q4 metrics.
fixes: In the sentence "Operating Income rose to €477 million.", add the corresponding net income figure for the quarter.
In the sentence "...celebrating our first full year of profitability.", add the exact full-year net profit amount.
In the paragraph beginning with "Monthly Active Users grew 12% Y/Y...", add the full-year 2024 total revenue amount.
